title: Structural Properties and Applications of the Augmented Sombor Index
summary: Topological indices are key quantitative descriptors in mathematical chemistry, unchanged under symmetry operations and retaining graph connectivity; they capture molecular structural features to provide insights into molecular stability and chemical properties, becoming indispensable in cheminformatics and theoretical chemistry. Among degree-based indices, the \textbf{Sombor index} is widely concerned for capturing structural information, and motivated by enhanced structural discrimination, the \textbf{augmented Sombor index} ($ASO$) is defined for a connected graph $Ω$ with $|V(Ω)|\geq 3$…
